objects.name: Weekly Revenue Dashboard Refresh & Publish
objects.description: Weekly refresh and publish of the Revenue Power BI dashboard for CFO/Finance leadership. Most time-sensitive of the three dashboards.

objects.name: Revenue Refresh SLA
objects.description: Source data must be available by 8 AM Monday; the report must be published by 10 AM Monday.

objects.name: SAP BW
objects.description: Source system for the Revenue dashboard; Finance runs a Sunday-night extraction job producing an Excel export.

objects.name: Hardcoded Revenue File Path
objects.description: Revenue Power BI file is hardcoded to D:\Data\PBI_Refresh\Revenue\Raw\; must be remapped or copied to that exact path on any other machine.

objects.name: Retrieve & Place Revenue Extract
objects.description: Download the Revenue_Weekly_YYYYMMDD.xlsx export from the Finance SharePoint site (Documents/Reports/Weekly Revenue Raw) and place it at the hardcoded local path without opening/resaving it.

objects.name: Revenue Row Count Expected Range
objects.description: Expected row count is ~2,000-2,500; below 1,500 or above 3,000 signals a likely SAP extraction problem.

objects.name: Validate Revenue Extract Data Quality
objects.description: Check row count against expected range, confirm no blanks in the Net Revenue column (F), and confirm the date column (B) only contains current-week dates.

objects.name: SAP Extraction Issue Contact
objects.description: Historically escalated to Suresh in Finance, who handles SAP extractions. Outgoing owner is not sure Suresh remains the right contact after handover.

objects.name: Hardcoded Local File Path Fragility
objects.description: All three dashboards depend on hardcoded local file paths; working from a different machine breaks refresh unless the path is manually remapped or replicated.

objects.name: Map Region Bucket via VLOOKUP
objects.description: Add a Region Group column via VLOOKUP(H2, Region_Lookup!A:B, 2, FALSE) against the Region_Lookup tab; unmapped region codes must be added manually and reported to Finance.

note: DEV_MODE default mock — supply mock_response for deterministic test data.
